Hi Logan,

Thanks again for taking a look at our draft. Attached is the current listing copy we plan to publish and a CSV with the procurement snippets our legal/procurement teams prefer (short meter text, billing contact, sample PO wording). We're hoping to get this finalized by the end of next week so AWS can schedule the co-sell enablement.

- Any objections to the proposed private offer trial wording in row 4 of the CSV?

From: Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwood.com>

Date: 2025-11-03T12:05:00-08:00
Subject: Re: AWS marketplace listing draft + procurement snippets

Hi Nora —

Thanks for sending this over. I reviewed the doc quickly and attached a marked-up version with three suggested edits (attached: marketplace_listing_v2.docx -> marketplace_listing_v2_marked.docx):

1) Shorten the first-paragraph hero to emphasize "predictable inference costs" (customers search for cost predictability on AWS).
2) Move the quickstart bullets into a separate "Getting started" accordion to reduce page clutter and match marketplace UX.
3) Add a single-line pricing footnote: "Usage pricing varies by region and instance type; quoted examples are illustrative." — this is a conservative approach that prevents procurement pushback while keeping the example visible.

On the procurement snippets CSV: the private offer trial wording is generally okay but we should swap the phrase "unmetered demo" for "time-limited demo with metered limits" (legal asked for clarity).

Next steps I propose:
- Kimberley/Kimberly, can you confirm the legal/footnote wording?
- Jonas, can you sanity-check the SKU naming and trial duration to align with our SKU matrix?
- Nora/Acme, if you agree we can produce a marketplace-ready copy and a single-row CSV that AWS can consume.

I included Paul from AWS to keep them looped for the co-sell timeline.

Thanks,
Logan Wright
Senior Partner Manager, Redwood Inference

Attachment: marketplace_listing_v2_marked.docx

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Date: 2025-11-04T09:42:00-08:00
Subject: Re: AWS marketplace listing draft + procurement snippets

On Mon, Nov 3, 2025 at 12:05 PM Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwood.com> wrote:
> Hi Nora —
>
> Thanks for sending this over. I reviewed the doc quickly and attached a marked-up version with three suggested edits...

Thanks for the clear notes, Logan. Quick legal redlines and ops notes below (keeps short so we can turn around fast):

Legal/Compliance redlines:
- The proposed pricing footnote you offered is fine, but we should append: "See Seller Terms for additional usage categories." This prevents ambiguous claims about SLA/credits.
- Change "time-limited demo with metered limits" -> "time-limited trial with metered usage limits" to match procurement language.

SKU/naming/ops (Jonas + Aditya):
- Jonas: update SKU to follow the pattern RED-ML-INF-<instance>-<region>; confirm whether we want to include a "-trial" SKU for the private offer.
- Aditya: confirm the sample PO wording in procurement_snippets.csv is compatible with our standard net-30 invoicing terms; flag any billing-contact mismatch.

I attached a one-line legal footnote we prefer to include under the pricing examples (ami-screenshot.png is for the small hero image placement):

"Footnote: Pricing examples are approximate and for illustrative purposes; actual charges are determined at time of consumption and may vary by region and instance type. For billing disputes contact billing@redwood.com."

If we can lock the one-line footnote and the trial terminology today, I can sign-off and Logan can push the marketplace-ready files to Paul at AWS.

Thanks,
Kimberly Park
Head of Marketplace Operations, Redwood Inference
Attachment: ami-screenshot.png

From: Nora Chen <nora.chen@acmeanalytics.com>

Logan / team —

Appreciate the quick turnaround and the legal language. Acme agrees to the revised trial wording and the suggested pricing footnote. Action items from our side:
- We'll accept the one-line footnote as written.
- I've asked our procurement lead to merge the CSV down to a single row with the agreed trial text; I'll send that by tomorrow.
- Please send the final marketplace copy to Paul so AWS can start the co-sell enablement checklist.

Next steps scheduled:

- Logan: once Paul confirms, can you provide a short one-page field playbook (1 pager) that sales can use for the co-sell kickoff?
- We'll be ready to sign the private offer once DocuSign arrives.
